hotels.title: Contemporary Hyderabad Indulgence near Airport with Pool & Onsite Dining
hotels.description: Discover true ease and comfort in this elegant Novotel sanctuary surrounded by tranquil gardens and situated mere minutes from Hyderabad's airport. Spend your days lounging by the shimmering outdoor pool or treat yourself to soothing treatments at the indulgent spa before retreating to your private room or suite. When hunger strikes, dine at The Food Exchange, a signature multi‑cuisine restaurant open all day, then unwind at The Gourmet Bar with well-crafted drinks. If you wish to explore, Hyderabad's cultural highlights like Charminar monument, Golconda Fort and the Chowmahalla Palace are all within a 30‑minute drive away.
